note: Farroad ascension gate v4, facing the lower left (right side nearer). Art pixels at the 544-tall battle scale. All gate pieces share the frame canvas origin. Draw order back to front: gate_glow (additive) < gate_doors (current frame) < gate_frame < gate_frame_runes + gate_doors_runes (fade in) < gate_arcs (additive) < stair steps (IN FRONT of the gate; top step first, each lower step over the one above). Everything stays behind the units.

gate_frame_runes.use: fade alpha 0->1 as the gate wakes

gate_doors.content: portal light with the two doors over it; frame 0 shut, last frame fully open (portal only)
gate_doors.play: once, about 1.2 s (10 fps), hold the last frame

gate_doors_runes.use: play in step with gate_doors, alpha fading in

gate_arcs.when: start when the doors are half open; loop while the gate stays open

stair_step.draw: in front of the gate; top step first so each lower (nearer) step overlaps the one above

light2d_suggestion.texture: GradientTexture2D radial, white centre -> transparent edge, about 512 px
light2d_suggestion.energy: 0 -> 1.1 over the door slide; flicker +-0.08, small spikes when an arc fires
light2d_suggestion.extra: second smaller PointLight2D (#fff4c4, energy 0.6) for the hot core
